name: ferroheme
description: Any iron(II)-porphyrin coordination complex. The differentia is the +2 oxidation state of the iron. This cannot be read from a SMILES string (ChEBI draws ferroheme b with a formally Fe(-2) centre and ferroheme a with a neutral one), and it is not a molecule-level property, so no current grouping meta-pattern can define this class. Members state it on their iron AtomOccurrence via oxidation_number.
